Read the page, not the popups

A Safari extension • by Luna Reader

Stop popups and blocking ads, automatically. Unblock and read most of the web, without leaving Safari. When you want the full Luna experience, it's one tap away. Don't worry. All your data is offline. There are no Luna servers to send anything to.

Turn it on in Safari

  1. Tap the page menu in the address bar
  2. Choose “Manage Extensions”
  3. Switch on Luna Reader
  4. Select Allow on all websites

Your browsing history and data is kept entirely on device. Luna works on your phone to improve your browsing experience and let you retrieve your own history locally.
